description: This elegant apartment is located in one of the most beautiful areas of Paris, just steps from the boutiques of rue Saint-Honoré and the Tuileries Gardens. It features two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a marble kitchen, and a lovely patio/winter garden for relaxing. Air conditioning and elevator. Its central location makes it the perfect base to enjoy the best of Paris.The spaceThis Parisian residence blends modern comfort with authentic charm. Designed by Genevieve Gorder, the celebrated American designer known for Trading Spaces and the Netflix series Stay Here, the apartment reflects a unique sensibility that combines warmth, elegance, and functionality. It features two beautifully appointed bedrooms—one with a queen-size bed and the other with two twin beds—each with its own en-suite bathroom with a shower, ensuring privacy and convenience. The spacious living room includes a sofa bed that can accommodate two additional guests and opens onto a delightful conservatory-style patio—a true haven of peace in the heart of the city. With thoughtful decor, modern amenities, and a welcoming atmosphere, this space is perfect for a stay that is both refined and relaxing. Tucked away in one of Paris’s most sought-after neighborhoods, just steps from the boutiques of rue Saint-Honoré, the Louvre, and the Tuileries Gardens, it offers the ideal base for experiencing the city’s cultural treasures and timeless elegance.Guest accessGuests will have access to the entire property.Other things to noteTo ensure a smooth and worry-free stay, we require a security guarantee. You may choose between a €500 deposit or a €49 waiver.
